title: Cross-Repository Compatibility Evidence Review
summary: Reviewed current Core, Editor, and Backend compatibility evidence and recorded a bounded no-promotion result: Editor and Backend gates pass against the current Core package boundary, while the Core default full gate has a fresh timeout failure and no live Editor-to-Backend-to-Core evidence is accepted.
expectedOutput: A Project Control evidence packet that classifies current Core, Editor, and Backend compatibility claims, gate results, blockers, risks, and unknowns without changing product runtime behavior or promoting FlowDoc truth.
riskSummary: Accepted cross-repository compatibility remains blocked by the fresh Core default npm run check timeout and by the missing live Editor client to Backend server to Core semantic integration proof.
